strings.FFR_conservatism_party_long: Parti Gaulliste de la France Libre
strings.FFR_military_administration_desc: Our current situation has forced Charles de Gaulle to put under military control most of our territory. The generals are free to befriend the local chiefs and leaders, giving them access to their personal troops. While it is an efficient method, this prevents us from knowing what is happening in the rest of the nation, and is leaving a lot of power in the hands of our generals.
strings.FFR_military_administration_2_desc:
War has come to Free France.

Our borders have come under siege, our soldiers march, and our state begins to mobilize against our enemies. The generals and officers of the military administration have prioritized the management and mitigation of the internal matters of the state, matters which will ensure the territory in our possession is effectively maintained and controlled.
strings.FFR_military_administration_3_desc:
The French march onward.

The military administration, through their efforts to manage our internal matters, have ensured our nation functions as an effective, lethal, and well-oiled machine. One which in their hands, will be guided towards our greater goal.

Our victory is within sight.
strings.FFR_precious_metal_desc: Though our economy might be shattered and our infrastructure destroyed, we still can exploit our ore mines. While the steel is not exported, because of its crucial importance in maintaining our equipment, we can still export valuable gold and bauxite to the willing buyers.
strings.FFR_spirit_french_desc: In the sole existence of Free France, the spirit of our long lasting democratic traditions still lives. While our armed hand on the continent is still the Résistance, even here in the deep lands of the Ivory Coast, we still fight for our ideals. Through the Comet Line, exiles were sent here from France and Belgium, believing in the all powerful nature of democracy and freedom, fighting for their country, even across oceans.
strings.FFR_tomb_republic_desc:
After their failed war in Western Africa, the last remnants of Free France have been reduced to occupying the lonely island of Kerguelen.

Kerguelen is a small landmass devoid of both strategic value and military resources. There is no hope of reclaiming the mainland for the exiles now, and like Napoleon and Saint Helena, the last scraps of Free France can now only wait for death to take them.

--------------
What our enemies, deserters and even allies deemed impossible is finally happening. Our troops are landing across the shores of France! We are not longer a rump state kept alive only by the weight of our former colonies, the hearts of our men and the sharp mind of our leader, we are the liberators of France!

We have no illusions that this is not a do or die situation, if we fail all it's over, but it we triumph our men will collect the fruits of their labor. The old ones will reconnect with their families and friends, and the young ones will grow old and die in their fatherland. Their tired eyes will be free to contemplate the beauty of Paris and the Seine for as long as they desire.
